name: 解说固定男音（与《黑色大丽花》参考片同款）
origin: Selected by the user in the dahlia voice audition (2026-09-09) and reproduced for zodiac1969 (2026-09-11, battle 00). This spec pins it so every future film uses the same narrator without being asked.
selection_procedure: 试听时明确要求：普通话（zh-CN）、男声（masculine）、解说（narration）。两个候选各听一遍，与本目录的参考样本（dahlia_male_narration_N01.mp3）对比，选音色最接近的那个；如果两个都不像，换下一组重新试听。配完后跑 `python3 production/check_voice.py --project production/<slug>`，不过闸门就不许进混音。

measured_reference.note: Median F0 per chapter, measured with this repo's own analyzer (production/check_voice.py): 40 ms frames / 20 ms hop, autocorrelation, voiced = RMS > 0.02 and peak > 0.35.
measured_reference.rejected_take_note: The first zodiac1969 take sounded female (median F0 168-200 Hz). It shipped before this gate existed; the gate exists so it cannot ship again.
